build_moe_runner_config: build an MoeRunnerConfig dataclass instance with MoE parameters like num_experts, top_k, hidden_size, and activation settings
register_fused_func: register a fused function mapping an A2A backend to a runner backend via FusedOpPool or the register_fused_func decorator
register_pre_permute: register a pre-permute function mapping a DispatchOutputFormat to a MoeRunnerBackend via PermuteMethodPool or the register_pre_permute decorator
register_post_permute: register a post-permute function mapping a MoeRunnerBackend to a CombineInputFormat via PermuteMethodPool or the register_post_permute decorator
run_moe_runner_core: run the MoeRunnerCore abstract method with RunnerInput, MoeQuantInfo, and running_state to produce a RunnerOutput
